business_lines: Manufacture and trade PE protective films, PE bags, biodegradable PE films, and biodegradable bags.
Manufacture and trade shrink films for packaged products such as cans, bags, bottles, etc.
Manufacture and supply films and bags tailored to custom packaging dimensions.
Process and assemble carton paper filters and synthetic fiber / fiberglass filter pads for paint booths.
Supply paper industry chemicals including coatings, release agents, polymers, de-inking agents, defoamers, and paper machine cleaning chemicals.
